newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia share volume leaps, Hansapank active.
newsitem.headline: Estonia share volume leaps, Hansapank active.

text.p: Estonian share trade was healthier on Wednesday, boosted by positive activity in the shares of leading bank, Hansapank, dealers said.
Overall turnover was 13.4 million kroons versus yesterday's 2.0 million kroons. The Tallinn stock exchange index moved marginally lower, losing 0.03 percent to 97.71.
Hansapank accounted for 8.1 million kroons of business and it closed at an unchanged 94.30 kroons.
"There were two big block trades with Hansapank, 20,000 and 50,000 shares changed hands before the end of trade," said Charlie Viikberg, a dealer with Savings Bank.
Shares in Forexpank were also well traded, registering business of 2.6 million kroons and its shares eased to 76.65 kroons from 77.25 kroons.
Savings Bank shares traded 1.2 million kroons and it closed at 37.40, slightly higher than on Tuesday.
The secondary free market had volume of 1.1 million kroons and shares in the Estiko conglomerate were most traded on business of 600,000 kroons. Its shares closed at 29.24 kroons versus 29.40 kroons.
